premises.text: Digital art creation remains a mostly manual process whose rising quality has driven unsustainable cost and schedule
premises.evidence_span: as the quality has increased, so have the costs

premises.text: Artematics is an example-based generative system that invents new art while artists paint with content under control
premises.evidence_span: instead of painting with colors, artists are painting with content

premises.text: Automation focuses on tedious high-volume art tasks artists dislike, not creative direction
premises.evidence_span: We automate the kind of work they don't want to do

premises.text: Beachhead is video games with cloud delivery and SaaS monetization for the wider industry
premises.evidence_span: We're going to monetize through a software-as-a-service business model

value.text: Halve time and cost of digital media creation
value.evidence_span: Our goal is to half the time and half the cost of this process through automation

secondary_value.text: Vitamin upside of richer, more varied game worlds
secondary_value.evidence_span: we're also a vitamin. We can take gaming to the next level

causal_links.evidence_span: disruptive new way of making art
solve the problem that art costs too much and it takes too long

notes: Beachhead and SaaS combined into one commercial premise to avoid over-splitting. Patents folded into capability. Closing vision uncoded.
